skill.name: linear-projects-write
skill.description: Create and update Linear projects from AI tools with Bun CLI commands.
skill.summary: Create and update Linear projects through documented Bun CLI commands.
skill.author: Bind

security_audit.summary: The confirmed issues are the LINEAR_API_KEY requirement, recommended .env storage, and the write-capable Linear workflow. Most external command detections are Markdown backtick false positives, and the bun.sh link is benign documentation. An additional business-logic risk exists because partial project-name matching can update the wrong project.

remediation.issue: LINEAR_API_KEY is required for write operations.
remediation.suggestion: Document least-privilege token use, secure secret storage, and rules that prevent printing or persisting the token.

remediation.issue: The docs recommend .env storage for credentials.
remediation.suggestion: Load only the required variable and warn users not to commit .env files.

remediation.issue: Update commands support partial project-name matching.
remediation.suggestion: Require exact UUIDs or display the matched project and require confirmation before each write.

remediation.issue: Write commands lack documented dry-run behavior.
remediation.suggestion: Add a dry-run mode and confirmation step for create and update operations.

remediation.issue: Referenced implementation files were not present in the audited package.
remediation.suggestion: Publish the create and update script sources so reviewers can inspect credential handling and Linear API behavior.

semantic_findings.title: Write Operations Can Target the Wrong Linear Project
semantic_findings.description: The skill supports project updates by UUID or name, and the notes allow case-insensitive partial name matching. Without a documented confirmation step, an agent could modify the wrong Linear project.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The update command accepts project names and the notes confirm partial matching. This is a clear business-logic risk for write operations.

content.user_title: Manage Linear Projects with AI CLI Commands
content.value_statement: Project changes in Linear can be slow when copied from AI planning sessions. This skill provides Bun CLI commands for creating and updating projects with key fields.
actual_capabilities: Create Linear projects with name and team assignments.
Set project description, lead, status, dates, and priority.
Update existing projects by UUID or project name.
Resolve user names for project lead updates.
Return machine-readable output when the JSON option is used.
limitations: Requires Bun and a valid LINEAR_API_KEY.
Uses write operations that can change live Linear data.
Partial project-name matching can select an unintended project.
The audited package does not include the referenced implementation files.

use_cases.title: Plan New Initiatives
use_cases.description: Create project records with teams, owners, timelines, and priority from an AI planning session.

use_cases.title: Update Delivery Status
use_cases.description: Change status, target dates, or leads as project details change.

use_cases.title: Standardize Project Setup
use_cases.description: Apply consistent fields when teams start recurring roadmap work.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a Linear project named "API Cleanup" for the Engineering team. Ask before running the command.

prompt_templates.title: Add Planning Metadata
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Linear project for Engineering and Product with a lead, priority, start date, and target date.

prompt_templates.title: Update by Identifier
prompt_templates.prompt: Update the project with the provided UUID to started, set the target date, and explain the changes before execution.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Multiple Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare commands to create one project and update another. Require confirmation for each write operation and summarize the expected Linear changes.

output_examples.input: Create a project named Mobile Launch for Engineering and Product.
output: Next action: confirm creation before writing to Linear.

output_examples.input: Update the onboarding project to completed.
output_examples.output: The project match is checked, the status change is reviewed, and the update is ready for confirmation.

output_examples.input: Set the security audit project to high priority with a March target date.
output_examples.output: The requested priority and target date are prepared, with the matched project shown before any update runs.

best_practices: Confirm every create or update command before it writes to Linear.
Use project UUIDs for updates when several projects have similar names.
Store LINEAR_API_KEY securely and avoid committing .env files.
anti_patterns: Running updates from partial names without checking the matched project.
Using a broad API key in shared environments.
Assuming JSON output means the change is safe or reversible.

faq.question: Does this skill need a Linear API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires LINEAR_API_KEY for authenticated Linear project writes.

faq.question: Can it create Linear projects?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented create command accepts project name, teams, lead, dates, status, and priority.

faq.question: Can it update existing projects?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented update command can change name, description, lead, status, dates, and priority.

faq.question: Does it delete Linear projects?
faq.answer: No evidence found in the audited files. The documented commands only create and update projects.

faq.question: Why is this skill security sensitive?
faq.answer: It handles a Linear API key and performs write operations that can change workspace data.

faq.question: What should I verify before running it?
faq.answer: Check the project name, team names, lead, dates, priority, and matched project identifier.
